scope: Bounded dictionary-verified sein participle preference in German spelling, plus repaired preposition-message merge regression. No dictionary or model asset change.

bounds.requires: Matching pronoun plus present/past sein and a reviewed form at the local clause edge. Existing protected, literal, grapheme, known-word, case, ignored-word, personal-vocabulary and candidate-budget handling is preserved.

merge_repair: Restore existing preposition-specific default message; pass incoming generic message explicitly to verb/copula contexts. Both rule identities and behavior retained.
